To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the costs of providing antimalarial treatment at a public healthcare facility in Nigeria were US$31.50 per case, (2) the costs of personnel were the highest component of costs, (3) the costs of malaria treatment represented 25% of total hospital costs, and (4) the cost per case was highly sensitive to changes in personnel costs, antimalarial drug prices and malaria case prevalence.
the cost of treating uncomplicated malaria at a public healthcare facility in Nigeria is US$31.48 per case.

the total annual costs of N 28.7 million were spent by the public health facility on the treatment for uncomplicated Malaria at the rate of US$ 31.5 per case, which represents about 25% of total expenditure of the health facility.
